name: ember of the fire giant
desc: You’ve manifested the fiery power of fire giants, granting you the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You have resistance to fire damage.

- Searing Cloud: As a bonus action, you can cause a cloud of embers to surround you. For 1 minute, the cloud provides you with half cover, and any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of you takes fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
